title: RAP-WAM: Learning World-Action Models through Predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations
title_zh: RAP-WAM：通过预测性演练与动作扰动学习世界-动作模型

paragraphs.en: Recent world action models draw on video generation priors to jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Adapting these priors to control requires determining how future predictions should guide policy learning. RAP-WAM combines predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations (RAP) with future-supervised queries and Coupled Action Projection for policy learning. Predictive rehearsal trains on model-generated inputs while retaining recorded targets, and accumulates recurring errors into a spatial prior. We perturb actions and measure changes in video predictions. Action-response-based spatiotemporal credit assignment combines these responses, prediction error, and the rehearsal prior to allocate visual supervision; spatially aggregating the responses determines supervision intensity across future action steps. No separate scoring network or deployment-time probe is required. The base learns from a video-pretrained backbone without intermediate pretraining on external embodied data. We evaluate the fixed base and its agent-refined, task-conditioned system. On 42 RoboDojo tasks, their average success rates are 12.85% and 15.62%, with Scores of 17.86 and 20.59. Across 15 real-robot tasks, the complete system achieves 89.00% task-macro-average success, exceeding the strongest of five baselines by 37.67 percentage points. Across 315 fixed-output simulation windows, 45.21% of response-top20 positions fall outside error-top20, revealing information beyond prediction error.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的世界动作模型利用视频生成先验知识，联合预测未来观察结果和机器人动作。 将这些先验知识应用于控制需要确定未来预测应如何指导策略学习。 RAP-WAM 将预测性排练与动作扰动（RAP）和未来监督查询及耦合动作投影相结合，用于策略学习。 预测性排练使用模型生成的输入进行训练，同时保留记录的目标，并将重复出现的错误累积为空间先验知识。 我们对动作进行扰动，并测量视频预测的变化。 基于动作响应的时空信用分配方法结合了这些响应、预测误差和排练先验知识以分配视觉监督；对响应进行空间聚合可确定未来各动作步骤的监督强度。 无需独立的评分网络或部署时的探测机制。 基础模型直接从视频预训练的骨干网络中学习，无需在外部具身数据上进行中间预训练。 我们评估了固定基础模型及其经过智能体优化、任务条件化的系统。 在 42 个 RoboDojo 任务中，它们的平均成功率分别为 12.85% 和 15.62%，得分分别为 17.86 和 20.59。 在 15 个真实机器人任务中，完整系统的任务宏观平均成功率为 89.00%，比五个基线模型中最强的一个高出 37.67 个百分点。 在 315 个固定输出的模拟窗口中，45.21% 的响应 top20 位置位于误差 top20 之外，这表明其中包含了预测误差之外的信息。

paragraphs.en: Generative robot policies combine visual representations with continuous action generation, as exemplified by Diffusion Policy and π 0 \pi_{0} ( Chi et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2024 ) . World action models additionally predict future observations: UWM couples video and action diffusion ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) ; DreamZero builds on pretrained video diffusion ( Ye et al., 2026b ) ; X-WAM incorporates multi-view RGB-D prediction and asynchronous denoising ( Guo et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: OpenWAM studies backbone inheritance, world action interaction, and embodied-pretraining scale ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . We focus on adapting video priors directly to target-task demonstrations: which visual locations and future action steps should receive additional training emphasis? Earlier work offers complementary perspectives. Prioritized replay changes how frequently experience transitions are reused ( Schaul et al., 2016 ) , while value-aware model learning incorporates decision structure into prediction losses ( Farahmand et al., 2017 ) . These motivate distinguishing prediction accuracy from policy relevance; allocating supervision across visual locations and future action steps in joint video–action models remains an open problem.
paragraphs.zh: OpenWAM 研究了主干继承、世界与动作的交互，以及具身预训练的规模（Wang 等，2026）。 我们专注于将视频先验知识直接适配到目标任务的演示中：哪些视觉位置和未来动作步骤应获得额外的训练重点？ 早期的研究提供了互补性的视角。 优先重播改变了经验转换被重复使用的频率（Schaul 等，2016），而价值感知模型学习则将决策结构纳入了预测损失函数（Farahmand 等，2017）。 这些研究促使我们区分预测准确性与策略相关性；在联合视频-动作模型中，如何在视觉位置和未来动作步骤之间分配监督信号仍是一个开放问题。

paragraphs.en: We introduce RAP-WAM, coupling predictive rehearsal with action perturbations to guide representations and supervision. Its central signal is the video prediction’s response to perturbations of the model’s action input. Prediction error measures target mismatch, whereas this response reveals which visual locations and future times depend more strongly on the action representation. Combining them distinguishes prediction difficulty from action dependence, providing a shared basis for prioritizing visual and action prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 RAP-WAM，它将预测性排练与动作扰动相结合，以引导表示和监督。 其核心信号是视频预测对模型动作输入扰动的响应。 预测误差衡量目标的不匹配，而这种响应则揭示了哪些视觉位置和未来的时间点更强烈地依赖于动作表示。 将两者结合，可以区分预测难度与动作依赖性，从而为优先处理视觉预测和动作预测提供共同基础。

sents.en: We introduce RAP-WAM, coupling predictive rehearsal with action perturbations to guide representations and supervision.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 RAP-WAM，它将预测性排练与动作扰动相结合，以引导表示和监督。

sents.en: Its central signal is the video prediction’s response to perturbations of the model’s action input.
sents.zh: 其核心信号是视频预测对模型动作输入扰动的响应。

sents.en: Prediction error measures target mismatch, whereas this response reveals which visual locations and future times depend more strongly on the action representation.

sents.zh: 将两者结合，可以区分预测难度与动作依赖性，从而为优先处理视觉预测和动作预测提供共同基础。

paragraphs.en: The framework couples three designs. Recorded future observations supervise predictive queries, giving action generation access to future-oriented features. Predictive rehearsal conditions subsequent demonstration segments on model-predicted observations while retaining recorded targets ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Bengio et al., 2015 ) , and accumulates recurring errors into a spatial prior. The credit mechanism integrates this prior with current error and action response: spatial maps guide visual supervision, while spatially pooled response weights future action steps. Together, these designs turn existing demonstrations into representation targets, rehearsed inputs, and adaptive supervision without extra region annotations or a separate scoring network.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架结合了三种设计。 记录的未来观察结果对预测查询进行监督，使动作生成能够利用面向未来的特征。 预测性演练将后续演示片段基于模型预测的观察结果进行条件约束，同时保留已记录的目标（Huang et al., 2025; Bengio et al., 2015），并将重复出现的错误累积为空间先验。 信用机制将此先验与当前错误及动作响应相整合：空间地图指导视觉监督，而空间池化后的响应权重则影响未来的动作步骤。 这些设计共同将现有演示转化为表示目标、演练输入和自适应监督，无需额外的区域标注或独立的评分网络。

sents.en: The framework couples three designs.
sents.zh: 该框架结合了三种设计。

paragraphs.en: We develop RAP-WAM to adapt video priors through future-supervised action representations and predictive rehearsal: recorded futures shape action-generating features, while rehearsal exposes the policy to observations affected by its own prediction errors.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了 RAP-WAM，通过未来监督的动作表示和预测性演练来适应视频先验：记录的未来塑造了动作生成特征，而演练则使策略能够接触到受其自身预测错误影响的观察数据。

paragraphs.en: We design an action-response-driven spatiotemporal credit mechanism: action response, current prediction error, and a historical error prior guide visual supervision, while spatially pooling the same response allocates supervision across future action steps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一种以动作-响应为驱动力的时空信用机制：动作响应、当前预测误差以及历史误差先验共同引导视觉监督，而对相同响应的空间池化则能将监督分配至未来的各个动作步骤。

paragraphs.en: We integrate execution-guided post-training with task-specific policy retention, using evaluation feedback to refine demonstration sampling and preserve complementary specializations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将执行引导的后续训练与任务特定的策略保留相结合，利用评估反馈来优化演示采样，并保留互补的专业化能力。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the action and world action formulations introduced above, UniPi derives actions from video plans through inverse dynamics ( Du et al., 2023 ) . Motus and MotuBrain use multimodal expert architectures ( Bi et al., 2026 ; MotuBrain Team et al., 2026 ) . GigaWorld-Policy emphasizes action-centered joint learning ( Ye et al., 2026a ) ; AHA-WAM uses asynchronous video planning ( Cai et al., 2026 ) , while Fast-WAM retains video co-training without test-time future imagination ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . Our focus is how existing target demonstrations supervise a joint policy. Further context on action interfaces and adaptive supervision appears in Appendix I .
paragraphs.zh: 除了上文介绍的行动和世界行动公式之外，UniPi 还通过逆动力学从视频计划中推导出行动（Du et al., 2023）。 Motus 和 MotuBrain 使用多模态专家架构（Bi et al., 2026；MotuBrain Team et al., 2026）。 GigaWorld-Policy 强调以行动为中心的联合学习（Ye et al., 2026a）；AHA-WAM 使用异步视频规划（Cai et al., 2026），而 Fast-WAM 则保留了视频协同训练，无需在测试时进行未来想象（Yuan et al., 2026）。 我们的重点是现有目标演示如何对联合策略进行监督。 关于行动接口和自适应监督的更多背景信息见附录 I。

paragraphs.en: RECAP improves π 0.6 \pi_{0.6} into π 0.6 ∗ \pi^{*}_{0.6} through reinforcement learning from demonstrations, autonomous experience, and expert corrections ( Intelligence et al., 2025 ) . SIME selects interaction segments ( Jin et al., 2025 ) ; RISE optimizes policies through imagined outcomes ( Yang et al., 2026a ) . ENPIRE supports agent-directed experiments ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , while ASPIRE retains validated program repairs ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . Our agent instead guides world action policy training on existing demonstrations; response-based credit allocates supervision, and evaluation retains complementary task specialists. The reported gains concern this combined procedure.
paragraphs.zh: RECAP 通过从演示、自主经验和专家修正中强化学习，将 π 0.6 \pi_{0.6} 改进为 π 0.6 ∗ \pi^{*}_{0.6}（Intelligence 等，2025）。 SIME 选择交互片段（Jin 等，2025）；RISE 通过想象结果优化策略（Yang 等，2026a）。 ENPIRE 支持智能体主导的实验（Xiao 等，2026），而 ASPIRE 则保留经过验证的程序修复（Lu 等，2026）。 我们的智能体则转而引导基于现有演示的世界动作策略训练；基于响应的信用分配负责监督，而评估则保留互补的任务专家。 所报告的增益涉及这一组合流程。

paragraphs.en: Training uses recorded images and joint states; deployment instead supplies observations affected by the robot’s preceding actions ( Ross et al., 2011 ) . Scheduled sampling ( Bengio et al., 2015 ) and Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) motivate exposing sequence models to their own predictions. For two adjacent demonstration chunks, we generate the first chunk’s future video and actions without gradients and replace the second chunk’s initial observation with the last predicted frame. Scheduled state substitution optionally replaces its initial state with the last predicted absolute-joint action, first unnormalized as an action and then normalized as a state. The predicted image and recorded second-chunk future frames are jointly VAE-encoded; recorded actions remain the targets. Their video/action flow losses form ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} , without an extra query-alignment loss. This rehearsal trains on predicted inputs while retaining recorded supervision; its schedules are in Appendix C.1 . An initially zero spatial prior 𝒫 \mathcal{P} accumulates the resulting prediction errors across updates. paragraphs.en: Prioritized replay and focal loss allocate learning emphasis using error signals ( Schaul et al., 2016 ; Lin et al., 2017 ) . Our credit mechanism adds action-conditioned response and shares it across visual and action supervision. response-based credit compares two forwards of the same recorded demonstration. paragraphs.en: The base objective supervises predictions and query features, rehearsal substitutes predicted images and states, and credit scales individual loss terms. At deployment, the queries, directional mask, and CAP remain active during joint video-latent/action denoising. We return unnormalized actions without decoding future RGB; neither rehearsal nor credit estimation is invoked. Architecture and sampling details are given in Appendix C.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 基础目标负责监督预测和查询特征，排练环节用预测的图像和状态进行替代，而信用评分则对各个损失项进行加权。 在部署阶段，查询、方向掩码和 CAP 在联合视频潜在变量/动作去噪过程中始终保持激活状态。 我们不进行未来 RGB 解码，直接返回未归一化的动作；此时既不会触发排练，也不会调用信用评分。 架构与采样细节见附录 C.1。

paragraphs.en: We implement the replay intervention with 50% natural replay, 20% task-balanced replay, 15% failure-boundary windows, and 15% late-progress windows. Natural replay preserves coverage; task-balanced replay equalizes task sampling. Boundary replay favors demonstration phases near progress inferred from failed executions’ partial-completion scores; late replay favors the final portion of demonstrations. The score-to-progress mapping is a sampling heuristic, not a measured failure time. Training retains recorded images and action targets, uses the RAP-WAM objectives with separate backbone and interface learning rates, and evaluates intermediate checkpoints. Appendix H specifies eligibility, fallback rules, optimizer settings, and budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用重播干预策略，其中自然重播占 50%，任务平衡重播占 20%，失败边界窗口占 15%，晚期进展窗口占 15%。 自然重播保留了覆盖范围；任务平衡重播则均衡了任务的采样比例。 边界重播优先选择基于失败执行的部分完成分数所推断出的进展附近的演示阶段；晚期重播则优先选择演示的末尾部分。 分数到进展的映射是一种采样启发式方法，而非经过测量的失败时间。 训练过程保留已记录的画面和行动目标，使用 RAP-WAM 目标函数，并为骨干网络和接口设置独立的学習率，同时评估中间检查点。 附录 H 详细说明了资格标准、备用规则、优化器设置和资源预算。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the fixed RAP-WAM base and the post-trained task-conditioned system on RoboDojo, analyze their supervision signals, and report physical execution results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 RoboDojo 上评估了固定的 RAP-WAM 基线和后训练的基于任务的系统，分析了它们的监督信号，并报告了物理执行结果。

paragraphs.en: We report SR and partial-completion Score, averaged within each capability and then equally across the five capabilities ( Chen et al., 2026a ) . Public results are taken from the RoboDojo leaderboard ( Chen et al., 2026b ) ; coverage and system accounting are specified in Appendices A and H . Across the 42 tasks, the full method achieves 15.62% average SR and 20.59 Score , compared with 12.85% and 17.86 for the RAP-WAM base. The gains are 2.77 percentage points in SR and 2.73 Score. Precision increases from 16.51% to 21.03%, Memory from 7.00% to 9.33%, and Generalization from 7.50% to 10.50%. These gains arise in the task-conditioned system, where retained specializations contribute across different capability groups.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了 SR 和局部完成度得分，先对每种能力进行平均，再在五种能力之间均分（Chen et al., 2026a）。 公开结果取自 RoboDojo 排行榜（Chen et al., 2026b）；覆盖范围和系统说明见附录 A 和 H。 在 42 项任务中，完整方法实现了 15.62% 的平均 SR 和 20.59 的得分，而 RAP-WAM 基线模型分别为 12.85% 和 17.86。 提升幅度为 SR 提高 2.77 个百分点，得分提高 2.73。 精确率从 16.51% 提升至 21.03%，记忆能力从 7.00% 提升至 9.33%，泛化能力从 7.50% 提升至 10.50%。 这些提升源于任务相关的系统，其中保留的专门化能力在不同能力组中均有所贡献。

paragraphs.en: Long-Horizon success rises from 32.50% to 36.50% , with Score increasing from 45.12 to 48.43 (Table 1 ). At the task level, tower building increases from 60% to 72%, pen-holder filling from 6% to 18%, and tic-tac-toe from 80% to 86%. The task-policy breakdown is given in Appendix D . Open success remains 0.75%, and random-Generalization success remains zero, indicating that the observed gains do not resolve broad scene-shift robustness. The candidate comparison in Appendix Figure 12 helps explain this pattern: the base has the highest aggregate performance among individual checkpoints, yet candidates improve different task subsets. Task-specific retention preserves these local gains despite regressions elsewhere. Appendix Figure 11 shows how the retained specialists divide the task set; their value is not captured by ranking whole-policy averages alone.
paragraphs.zh: 长期成功率为 32.50% 提升至 36.50%，得分从 45.12 增至 48.43（表 1）。 在任务层面，塔楼建造成功率从 60% 提升至 72%，笔筒填充率从 6% 提升至 18%，井字棋任务的成功率则从 80% 提升至 86%。 任务策略的细分情况见附录 D。 开放场景的成功率仍为 0.75%，随机泛化成功率仍为零，表明观察到的提升并未解决跨场景变化的广泛鲁棒性问题。 附录图 12 中的候选模型对比有助于解释这一模式：基础模型在单个检查点中表现出最高的综合性能，但各候选模型对不同的任务子集有不同程度的改进。 任务特定的保留机制在其他部分出现性能下降的情况下，仍保留了这些局部提升。 附录图 11 展示了这些保留的专用智能体如何划分任务集；仅通过排序整体策略的平均值无法完全体现其价值。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 a–b uses 315 RoboDojo windows across 35 conditions. Holding model predictions fixed, we separately remove the historical error prior, action response, or current-error contribution and renormalize the remaining weights to compare their effects on supervision allocation (Appendix E ). paragraphs.en: Two complementary patterns emerge: response and error prioritize different prediction locations, whereas candidate policies specialize on different tasks. The former concerns within-policy supervision; the latter concerns task-level selection. Separating their contributions requires budget-matched training ablations and policy selection independent of final testing. Weak Open and random-Generalization performance motivates new-layout evaluation. Specialist retention additionally requires checkpoint storage and reliable task identities.
paragraphs.zh: 出现了两种互补的模式：响应和错误优先关注不同的预测位置，而候选策略则专注于不同的任务。 前者涉及策略内部的监督；后者涉及任务层面的选择。 要区分它们的贡献，需要进行预算匹配的训练消融分析，以及独立于最终测试的策略选择。 较弱的开放性和随机泛化性能促使我们采用新的布局进行评估。 保留专家策略还需要存储检查点并确保任务标识的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: We presented RAP-WAM, a world action framework coupling future-supervised action representations with predictive rehearsal. Its action-response signal organizes both spatial visual and temporal action supervision, complemented by current and persistent prediction errors. The framework gives future prediction two connected roles: shaping representations for action generation and supplying feedback that guides subsequent learning. Simulation and physical evaluations demonstrate the capabilities of the resulting policies, while task-specific post-training preserves complementary specializations within the complete system. Together, these findings motivate a unified treatment of predictive representation, supervision allocation, and task-level capability retention for world action models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 RAP-WAM，这是一种将未来监督的动作表示与预测性演练相结合的世界动作框架。 其动作-响应信号整合了空间视觉和时序动作的监督信息，并辅以当前和持续的预测误差。 该框架赋予未来预测两个相互关联的角色：塑造用于动作生成的表示，以及提供指导后续学习的反馈。 模拟和物理评估展示了由此产生的策略的能力，而任务特定的训练后处理则在完整系统中保留了互补的专业化能力。 综合来看，这些发现推动了世界动作模型中预测性表示、监督分配和任务级能力保留的统一处理。

paragraphs.en: Generative AI assisted with research discussions, post-training intervention design, implementation and experiment scripts, literature retrieval, manuscript drafting and translation, and figure preparation. The improvement agents used in the experimental workflow and their role in proposing training interventions are described in Section 3.4 and Appendix H ; their outputs are part of the method under study. During manuscript preparation, assistance included checking citation records against primary sources, comparing reported values with saved experiment records, and compiling and inspecting the manuscript. All results reported in this paper have been manually reviewed by the authors. World-model predictions in Appendix J are identified as model outputs and paired with recorded targets. Reported quantitative results come from saved experiments or cited benchmark sources; pending measurements are not replaced with generated values. AI systems are not authors, and responsibility for the scientific claims, source attribution, code, and final submitted content remains with the authors.

paragraphs.en: This research does not involve human-subject experiments or user studies. We evaluate robot manipulation policies using robot demonstrations and simulation and real-robot execution records. Physical execution can cause unintended contact or motion; responsible deployment requires embodiment-specific checks of joint conventions and limits, an emergency stop, and supervised commissioning. Improved benchmark performance does not establish safety outside the evaluated conditions. Recorded demonstration frames and training-sample predictions are presented as qualitative evidence, not as additional autonomous-success trials. Display copies mask incidental identifying text, visible robot torsos in external-view sequences, and background faces in prediction comparisons; task-relevant numerals and mahjong symbols are retained. Original scene content is otherwise preserved, and the processing is disclosed in Appendices G and J . Masking alone does not establish consent or authorize redistribution: public release of demonstrations or identifiable recordings remains subject to the applicable dataset terms, participant permissions, and institutional requirements. No approval or consent status is inferred from the availability of these recordings. The limitations of task-conditioned selection, single-seed evaluation, and incomplete physical measurements are stated to avoid overstating generalization or autonomous capability.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究不涉及人类受试者实验或用户研究。 我们使用机器人演示、模拟以及真实机器人的执行记录来评估机器人操控策略。 物理执行可能导致意外接触或运动；负责任的部署需要针对具体实体进行关节规范与极限的检查、设置紧急停止，并在监督下完成调试。 基准性能的提升并不能证明在评估条件之外的安全性。 已录制的演示帧和训练样本预测作为定性证据呈现，而非作为额外的自主成功试验。 展示副本对偶发的身份识别文本、外部视角序列中可见的机器人躯干以及预测比较中的背景人脸进行了遮蔽；与任务相关的数字和麻将符号则予以保留。 场景的其他原始内容均得以保留，相关处理过程在附录 G 和 J 中有详细说明。 仅通过遮蔽并不能确立同意或授权再分发：演示或可识别记录的公开发布仍受适用数据集条款、参与者许可及机构要求的约束。 这些记录的存在并不表示已获得任何批准或同意。 本研究明确指出了任务条件化选择、单一种子评估以及物理测量不完整等局限性，以避免夸大其泛化能力或自主能力。

paragraphs.en: We provide the source code in the supplementary materials. Section 3 defines the model interfaces, predictive rehearsal, response-based credit objective, and task-specific policy selection. Appendix A documents training and evaluation conventions, while Appendix C , including Algorithm 1 , provides implementation details, assumptions, and derivations. Appendix H specifies post-training sampling, optimizer settings, checkpoint retention, inference, and aggregation; Appendix D reports task-level outcomes. Appendices E and F describe the diagnostic sampling and reconstruction procedures. The scope and processing of physical recordings and the selection of paired training predictions are described in Appendices G and J . The project records preserve source paths, hashes, selection manifests, and figure-generation scripts. These records support auditing the presented artifacts. Remaining reproducibility limits include the absence of independent policy-selection testing, multi-seed estimates, and completed physical-trial statistics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在补充材料中提供了源代码。 第 3 节定义了模型接口、预测性排练、基于响应的信用目标以及任务特定的策略选择。 附录 A 记录了训练和评估的惯例，而附录 C（包括算法 1）则提供了实现细节、假设和推导过程。 附录 H 规定了训练后的采样、优化器设置、检查点保留、推理和聚合方法；附录 D 报告了任务层面的结果。 附录 E 和 F 描述了诊断性采样和重建流程。 物理录音的范围与处理过程，以及配对训练预测的选择，在附录 G 和 J 中有详细说明。 项目记录保留了源路径、哈希值、选择清单以及图表生成脚本。 这些记录支持对已呈现成果进行审计。 其余的可重复性限制包括：缺乏独立的策略选择测试、多种子估计以及未完成的物理试验统计数据。

paragraphs.en: RAP-WAM initializes its shared transformer from Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video weights ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) and jointly learns future video and robot actions from target RoboDojo demonstrations. Action/state encoders, queries, and CAP are initialized for target-task training, without initialization from a separately trained robot policy. The base architecture contains no additional memory, mixture-of-experts, or post-training extension. Thus “without embodied pretraining” excludes an intermediate pretraining stage on external embodied data, whether for action-policy learning or joint world action modeling. It retains Wan video pretraining, pretrained text embeddings, and joint world action training on target robot demonstrations. The collection has 3,500 episodes, with 3,499 used for training and one for validation. The fixed RAP-WAM base is the reference for local mechanism analyses. Table 1 reports the complete post-training system, whose retained task policies build on this substrate. The settings in Table 2 describe the base learner, not the cumulative computation of the entire improvement process.
paragraphs.zh: RAP-WAM 从其 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 视频权重（Team Wan 等，2025）初始化共享变换器，并联合学习目标 RoboDojo 演示中的未来视频和机器人动作。 动作/状态编码器、查询和 CAP 为目标任务训练进行初始化，而无需从单独训练的机器人策略中初始化。 基础架构不包含额外的内存、专家混合模型或后训练扩展。 因此，“无具身预训练”排除了使用外部具身数据进行中间阶段预训练的可能性，无论该训练是用于动作策略学习还是联合世界动作建模。 它保留了 Wan 视频预训练、预训练的文本嵌入以及基于目标机器人演示的联合世界动作训练。 该数据集包含 3,500 个回合，其中 3,499 个用于训练，1 个用于验证。 固定的 RAP-WAM 基础架构是局部机制分析的依据。 表 1 报告了完整的后训练系统，其保留的任务策略建立在这一基础之上。 表 2 中的设置描述了基础学习器，而非整个改进过程的累积计算量。

paragraphs.en: RoboDojo policy evaluation uses 30 denoising steps and executes eight actions before replanning. Action smoothing uses a Savitzky–Golay filter with window 9 and polynomial order 2 on all 14 action coordinates. Four-action boundary blending uses new-chunk coefficients ( i + 1 ) / 5 (i+1)/5 for i = 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 i=0,1,2,3 . This filter is distinct from classifier-free guidance. Physical deployment additionally depends on robot-specific joint mappings, units, and control rates.
paragraphs.zh: RoboDojo 策略评估使用 30 个去噪步骤，并在重新规划前执行八个动作。 动作平滑在所有 14 个动作坐标上应用一个窗口大小为 9、多项式阶为 2 的 Savitzky–Golay 滤波器。 四动作边界融合使用新分块系数 ( i + 1 ) / 5 (i+1)/5，其中 i = 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 i=0,1,2,3 。 该滤波器与无分类器引导方法不同。 实际部署还取决于机器人特定的关节映射、单位和控制速率。

paragraphs.en: The target alignment projection is stopped along with its target features. The direct attention mask permits state-mediated information and shared-parameter updates. At per-device batch one, the optional local min–max difficulty correction vanishes. Spatial 𝒫 \mathcal{P} broadcasts uniformly in time, so its normalized temporal contribution also vanishes. The prior is zero until its first valid rehearsal update. Rehearsal and response-based credit are invoked according to their respective sampling probabilities. Only successfully computed auxiliary losses with nonzero weights enter the training objective. For each branch, the effective participation rate is the fraction of training updates satisfying these conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 目标对齐投影与其目标特征一同停止。 直接注意力掩码允许状态中介的信息和共享参数更新。 在每个设备的第一个批次中，可选的局部最小-最大难度校正消失。 空间 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 随时间均匀广播，因此其归一化的时间贡献也消失。 在首次有效排练更新之前，先验为零。 根据各自的采样概率调用基于排练和响应的信用机制。 只有成功计算且权重非零的辅助损失才会进入训练目标。 对于每个分支，有效参与率是满足这些条件的训练更新所占的比例。

sents.zh: 目标对齐投影与其目标特征一同停止。

sents.zh: 直接注意力掩码允许状态中介的信息和共享参数更新。

sents.en: At per-device batch one, the optional local min–max difficulty correction vanishes.
sents.zh: 在每个设备的第一个批次中，可选的局部最小-最大难度校正消失。

sents.en: Spatial 𝒫 \mathcal{P} broadcasts uniformly in time, so its normalized temporal contribution also vanishes.
sents.zh: 空间 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 随时间均匀广播，因此其归一化的时间贡献也消失。

sents.en: The prior is zero until its first valid rehearsal update.
sents.zh: 在首次有效排练更新之前，先验为零。

sents.en: Rehearsal and response-based credit are invoked according to their respective sampling probabilities.
sents.zh: 根据各自的采样概率调用基于排练和响应的信用机制。

sents.en: Only successfully computed auxiliary losses with nonzero weights enter the training objective.
sents.zh: 只有成功计算且权重非零的辅助损失才会进入训练目标。

sents.en: For each branch, the effective participation rate is the fraction of training updates satisfying these conditions.
sents.zh: 对于每个分支，有效参与率是满足这些条件的训练更新所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: G0.5 pretrains on robot demonstrations and web-scale vision–language data, with 14 real/simulated embodiments mapped to a shared action space ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . G0.5 therefore uses external embodied pretraining. Xiaomi-Robotics-1 and Hy use action-policy pretraining on handheld UMI demonstrations ( Xiaomi Robotics Team et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) ; these are action-labeled embodied trajectories, not necessarily robot-collected data. OpenWAM- α \alpha jointly pretrains future-video and action prediction on egocentric and robot data ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Its final mixture contains 6,369 hours of egocentric human and robot trajectories; human video is not itself labeled robot-action supervision. Our no-external-embodied-pretraining flag still includes Wan video initialization, pretrained text embeddings, and joint world action training on target robot demonstrations. Table 1 therefore defines “Pretrained” as an intermediate stage on external embodied data, including robot/UMI action-policy and joint world action pretraining, rather than asserting that every pretraining trajectory was robot-collected.
paragraphs.zh: G0.5 在机器人演示和大规模视觉-语言数据上进行预训练，其中 14 个真实/模拟实体被映射到一个共享的动作空间（Liu et al., 2026）。 因此，G0.5 使用了外部实体化预训练。 Xiaomi-Robotics-1 和 Hy 在手持 UMI 演示数据上进行了动作策略预训练（Xiaomi Robotics Team et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026）；这些是带有动作标签的实体化轨迹，并不一定是由机器人收集的数据。 OpenWAM-α \alpha 在自我中心视角数据和机器人数据上联合预训练了未来视频预测和动作预测（Wang et al., 2026）。 其最终混合模型包含 6,369 小时的自我中心视角人类和机器人轨迹；其中人类视频本身并非带有机器人动作标签的监督数据。 我们的“无外部实体化预训练”选项仍然包含了 Wan 视频的初始化、预训练的文本嵌入，以及在目标机器人演示数据上进行的联合世界动作训练。 因此，表 1 将“预训练”定义为一个基于外部实体化数据的中间阶段，包括机器人/UMI 动作策略预训练和联合世界动作预训练，而非断言所有预训练轨迹都由机器人收集。

paragraphs.en: The pretraining column summarizes the method’s reported use of external embodied data. InternVLA-A1.5 uses robot-episode pretraining ( Ma et al., 2026 ) ; VLAct and X-VLA use cross-embodiment robot pretraining, and MolmoAct2 uses action-data pretraining ( Yang et al., 2026b ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) . Spatial Forcing inherits the Pi-05 base, so both carry a positive embodied-pretraining flag ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 预训练列总结了该方法所报告的对外部具身数据的使用情况。 InternVLA-A1.5 使用了机器人片段预训练（Ma et al., 2026）；VLAct 和 X-VLA 使用了跨具身机器人预训练，而 MolmoAct2 则使用了动作数据预训练（Yang et al., 2026b；Zheng et al., 2026；Fang et al., 2026）。 Spatial Forcing 继承了 Pi-05 基础模型，因此两者都带有正向的具身预训练标志（Physical Intelligence et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: X-WAM reports more than 5,800 hours of robot-data pretraining ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . GigaWorld-Policy introduces embodied-video pretraining using robot and egocentric human data before target-task action training ( Ye et al., 2026a ) . AHA-WAM reports no robot-data pretraining in its default simulation setting, but its real-world comparison pretrains both AHA-WAM and Fast-WAM on 24,600 RoboCOIN trajectories (approximately 165 hours) ( Cai et al., 2026 ) . The AHA-WAM Yes flag refers to this reported real-world variant; it does not establish the initialization of the RoboDojo checkpoint. X-WAM and GigaWorld-Policy-0 are marked Yes based on their reported pretraining. Fast-WAM’s reported simulation configuration uses Wan initialization without external embodied pretraining ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: X-WAM 报告了超过 5,800 小时的机器人数据预训练（Guo 等人，2026）。 GigaWorld-Policy 在目标任务的行动训练之前，引入了结合机器人数据和以自我为中心的人类数据的具身视频预训练（Ye 等人，2026a）。 AHA-WAM 在其默认模拟设置中未报告任何机器人数据预训练，但在其真实世界对比实验中，对 AHA-WAM 和 Fast-WAM 均使用了 24,600 条 RoboCOIN 轨迹（约 165 小时）进行预训练（Cai 等人，2026）。 AHA-WAM 的“是”标志指的是此报告的真实世界变体；它并未确立 RoboDojo 检查点的初始化。 X-WAM 和 GigaWorld-Policy-0 基于其报告的预训练被标记为“是”。 Fast-WAM 所报告的模拟配置使用了 Wan 初始化，而未采用外部的具身预训练（Yuan 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: SimpleMemVLA uses timestamped visual history with a Qwen3.5-4B backbone and a flow-matching action head ( Yin et al., 2026 ) . Its released training recipe initializes the backbone from Qwen3.5-4B, constructs a new action head, and trains on each benchmark’s demonstrations without a separate embodied-pretraining stage. We therefore mark No under the definition above. The RoboDojo values use the official 23 September 2026 leaderboard snapshot, including separate standard and randomized Generalization results.
paragraphs.zh: SimpleMemVLA 使用带有时间戳的视觉历史，并以 Qwen3.5-4B 作为主干模型，搭配一个流匹配动作头（Yin 等，2026）。 其公开的训练方案从 Qwen3.5-4B 初始化主干模型，构建一个新的动作头，并在每个基准测试的演示数据上进行训练，无需单独的具身预训练阶段。 因此，根据上述定义，我们将其标记为“否”。 RoboDojo values 使用 2026 年 9 月 23 日的官方排行榜快照，其中包含标准版和随机化版的独立泛化结果。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 separates VLA and other action policies from world-model-based policies. The latter group includes OpenWAM- α \alpha , X-WAM, GigaWorld-Policy-0, AHA-WAM, Fast-WAM and our policy, which learn an explicit predictive world-model component alongside action generation. InternVLA-A1.5 is grouped with VLAs: its foresight tokens receive latent supervision from a frozen pretrained video model, but the policy does not learn pixel-level generation and discards the video branch at inference ( Ma et al., 2026 ) . Its ‡ \ddagger marker records this supervision source without classifying the policy as a world action model.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 将 VLA 和其他动作策略与世界模型 기반 策略区分开来。 后一类包括 OpenWAM-α \alpha、X-WAM、GigaWorld-Policy-0、AHA-WAM、Fast-WAM 以及我们的策略，这些策略在生成动作的同时会学习一个显式的预测性世界模型组件。 InternVLA-A1.5 被归入 VLA 类别：其前瞻性令牌通过一个冻结的预训练视频模型获得潜在监督，但该策略并不学习像素级生成，并在推理时丢弃视频分支（Ma et al., 2026）。 其 ‡ \ddagger 标记记录了这一监督来源，但并未将该策略归类为世界动作模型。

paragraphs.en: Xiaomi, Hy, Pi-05, VLAct, X-VLA and MolmoAct2 document action-generation objectives without an explicit predictive world-model component ( Xiaomi Robotics Team et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) . Spatial Forcing aligns observed geometry, not future scene evolution ( Li et al., 2026 ) ; its benchmark identity is the Pi-05-based variant. Action flow matching, current depth prediction, and textual subtask planning alone do not qualify as world modeling here. KinRT uses kinematics-supervised expert routing for action generation and is grouped with non-world-model policies ( Yang et al., 2026c ) . SimpleMemVLA is grouped with VLAs: its video context represents observed history, rather than an explicitly predicted future world state. These method-level labels neither make all architectures identical nor explain performance causally.
paragraphs.zh: Xiaomi、Hy、Pi-05、VLAct、X-VLA 和 MolmoAct2 在描述动作生成目标时，并未包含明确的预测性世界模型组件（Xiaomi Robotics Team 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026；Physical Intelligence 等，2025；Yang 等，2026b；Zheng 等，2026；Fang 等，2026）。 Spatial Forcing 对齐的是观测到的几何结构，而非未来场景的演化（Li 等，2026）；其基准身份是基于 Pi-05 的变体。 仅凭动作流匹配、当前深度预测和文本子任务规划，尚不足以在此被认定为世界建模。 KinRT 使用基于运动学监督的专家路由进行动作生成，并被归入非世界模型策略类别（Yang 等，2026c）。 SimpleMemVLA 被归入 VLA 类别：其视频上下文表示的是观测到的历史，而非明确预测的未来世界状态。 这些方法层面的标签既不能使所有架构完全相同，也无法对性能差异提供因果解释。

paragraphs.en: We use the linear interpolation and velocity-regression formulation of flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用流匹配中的线性插值和速度回归公式（Lipman 等人，2023）。

paragraphs.en: Observed visual latents are clamped and excluded from the future-only video loss. The video-initialized trunk is trained together with newly initialized action/state encoders, queries, and CAP on target demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 观察到的视觉潜在变量会被限制，并从仅基于未来的视频损失中排除。 经过视频初始化的主干网络与全新初始化的动作/状态编码器、查询和 CAP 一起在目标演示上进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Action and state encoders use Linear–SiLU–Linear projections, learned position embeddings, and LayerNorm. All four token groups share each block’s self-attention projections, text cross-attention, and feed-forward layers; there are no modality-specific transformer experts. Rotary position encoding applies only to video-token queries and keys. Predictive queries use action-side diffusion-time modulation. State tokens receive no additional diffusion-time modulation, but still undergo the block’s learned modulation and all updates. The mask in Equation 3 is applied identically at training and sampling: for i ∈ 𝒜 , j ∈ 𝒱 i\in\mathcal{A},j\in\mathcal{V} , the logit is suppressed; state-mediated paths remain.

paragraphs.en: The identities characterize the weighting rule, not its causal effect on success. No matched-budget, independently evaluated component ablation is reported here. A claim of signal-specific control benefit would require matching auxiliary computation, initialization, data, and checkpoint selection, and separating weighting information from gradient-scale changes. Normalizing weight sums does not match the full AdamW update. Numerical checks on affine and smooth toy maps verify the identities, not robot performance.
paragraphs.zh: 这些恒等式描述了加权规则，而非该规则对成功结果的因果影响。 本文未报告任何预算匹配且独立评估的组件消融分析。 若要主张信号特定的控制收益，则需匹配辅助计算、初始化、数据和检查点选择，并将加权信息与梯度尺度变化区分开来。 对权重总和进行归一化并不完全等同于 AdamW 更新。 对仿射和平滑玩具映射进行的数值验证证实了这些恒等式，而非机器人性能。

paragraphs.en: Thus removal sensitivity combines the source’s summed coefficients with its normalized spatial shape. It is neither a causal importance estimate nor an additive decomposition across sources. paragraphs.en: Panel c instead uses raw float32 𝒮 \mathcal{S} from one phone-packing validation demonstration, at window starts 63, 126, and 188. These windows use the physical-image diagnostic model and data described in Appendix F . Spatial means of raw 𝒮 \mathcal{S} are normalized over the four native future bins using the implemented 10 − 6 10^{-6} denominator floor. Their temporal ranges are respectively 3.6025 × 10 − 6 3.6025\times 10^{-6} , 5.6887 × 10 − 6 5.6887\times 10^{-6} , and 1.8406 × 10 − 6 1.8406\times 10^{-6} , so the floor is inactive in all three retained windows. The display shows four bin weights, each repeated over four consecutive action steps, alongside the exact unit reference when 𝒮 \mathcal{S} is removed. It does not use a normalized-map temporal proxy or 16 independently probed actions. Because 𝒫 \mathcal{P} is time-constant and this branch excludes ℰ \mathcal{E} , removing 𝒮 \mathcal{S} leaves unit temporal coefficients. The same action perturbation thus provides spatial and temporal selectivity without a second coefficient predictor. The displayed w w precedes the objective’s normalization q j a = w j / ∑ k w k q_{j}^{a}=w_{j}/\sum_{k}w_{k} ; even its unit reference is not a retrained ablation. The companion reproducibility materials retain the source correspondence and display specification.

paragraphs.en: Appendix E evaluates ∑ i b i ​ 𝒲 i / ∑ i 𝒲 i \sum_{i}b_{i}\mathcal{W}_{i}/\sum_{i}\mathcal{W}_{i} on the same windows under uniform 𝒲 i = 1 \mathcal{W}_{i}=1 , post-hoc error-only 𝒲 i = 1 + 0.5 ​ ℰ i \mathcal{W}_{i}=1+0.5\mathcal{E}_{i} , and full response-based credit 𝒲 i = 1 + 𝒫 i + 𝒮 i + 0.5 ​ ℰ i \mathcal{W}_{i}=1+\mathcal{P}_{i}+\mathcal{S}_{i}+0.5\mathcal{E}_{i} rules. The saved component maps are normalized; full weights are reconstructed from them rather than taken from float16-rounded stored 𝒲 \mathcal{W} . Each point is a median over nine windows in one condition, with median/IQR marks across 35 conditions. The respective medians are 20.00%, 20.9448% and 24.4003%; the error-only and response-based credit IQRs are 20.7050–21.2332% and 23.0325–25.3654%. Every condition-median share increases; the median paired difference is 3.7816 percentage points (range 0.8839–5.7004), not the difference of group medians. Adding both 𝒫 \mathcal{P} and 𝒮 \mathcal{S} prevents attribution to either signal alone; enrichment partly follows from including 𝒮 \mathcal{S} in both the weights and the selected set. paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows that the full credit rule assigns a larger weight share to response-top20 positions than error-only reweighting in every displayed condition. The medians across conditions are 24.40% and 20.94%, respectively. This supports the mechanism’s ability to alter supervision beyond error-only weighting; it does not measure a retrained success-rate gain. The source-removal distances also vary across conditions, showing that the same coefficient rule induces different allocations for different inputs. The 315 windows are descriptive samples, not independent policy evaluations; no confidence intervals or significance claims are inferred from these plots.
paragraphs.zh: 图7显示，在所有展示的条件下，完整信用规则为响应-top20位置分配的权重份额均高于仅基于错误的重新加权。 各条件下的中位数分别为24.40%和20.94%。 这支持了该机制能够超越仅基于错误的加权方式改变监督机制的能力；但这并未衡量重新训练后成功率的提升。 源移除距离在不同条件下也存在差异，表明相同的系数规则会对不同的输入产生不同的分配结果。 这315个窗口是描述性样本，而非独立的策略评估；这些图表中未推导出任何置信区间或显著性结论。

paragraphs.en: The simulation analysis uses 35 conditions with nine distinct demonstrations each. Conditions are defined using initial image, state, and logarithmic trajectory length; each demonstration contributes one middle valid window and one seeded draw of diffusion noise and action perturbation. Each map contains four future bins on a 24 × 20 24\times 20 grid. Within-window ranks use all 1,920 positions; condition summaries aggregate nine windows. Pixels and windows from the same condition are not independent policy evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 该模拟分析使用了 35 种条件，每种条件包含九次不同的演示。 条件的定义基于初始图像、状态以及对数轨迹长度；每次演示贡献一个中间有效窗口，以及一次预置的扩散噪声和动作扰动抽取。 每张地图在 24 × 20 的网格上包含四个未来时间桶。 窗口内的排名使用了全部 1,920 个位置；条件摘要则对九个窗口进行汇总。 来自同一条件的像素和窗口并非相互独立的策略评估。

paragraphs.en: Panel a of Figure 3 reads the native 14 × 14 14\times 14 EMA prior directly from the same can-placement run at steps 690, 4140, 8280, 12420, 16560, and 20700. Percentages are relative to the final step. The upper row selects steps 690, 12420 and 20700, independently normalized to show spatial shape. The lower row reports the arithmetic mean of the raw stored EMA at all six checkpoints on a logarithmic axis. The curve measures the training prior rather than held-out prediction error. The final prior is the one used in panels b–c. Panels b–c use the verified step-20,700 can-placement checkpoint and recorded training demonstration 8574282; these are not physical executions. Panel b retains start 112 (RGB offsets 114, 118, 122, 126), selected after screening 32 archived windows. Its square crop is x ∈ [ 48,176 ) x\in[48,176) , y ∈ [ 96,224 ) y\in[96,224) ; top40 membership and transitions are computed over the full 14 × 14 14\times 14 grid before cropping. Thus the crop can show fewer than 40 selected cells. The archived full-field tensors retain background responses.

paragraphs.en: Panel c instead includes all eleven exported windows, starts 0,16, … \ldots ,160, without localization-based selection. For each window let C j ∈ { 𝒫 , 𝒮 , 0.5 ​ ℰ } C_{j}\in\{\mathcal{P},\mathcal{S},0.5\mathcal{E}\} and 𝒲 = 1 + ∑ j C j \mathcal{W}=1+\sum_{j}C_{j} . The upper row reports 100 ​ ∑ C j / ∑ ( 𝒲 − 1 ) 100\sum C_{j}/\sum(\mathcal{W}-1) , with sums over all four future groups and all 196 spatial positions. The unit floor is excluded only from this composition ratio. The lower row normalizes 𝒲 \mathcal{W} and 𝒲 − C j \mathcal{W}-C_{j} separately over the same positions and reports 100 ​ TV 100\,\mathrm{TV} , where TV ⁡ ( p , q ) = 1 2 ​ ∑ | p − q | \mathrm{TV}(p,q)=\tfrac{1}{2}\sum|p-q| . The unit floor is retained in both distributions; no remaining component is recomputed or renormalized before this final distribution normalization. This measures sensitivity of the allocation rule at fixed outputs, not the effect of training without a component. Shared row scales are 0–100% and 0–5%; lower-row points denote available windows and lines connect adjacent observations. Upper-row stacked shares are linearly connected between adjacent windows.
paragraphs.zh: 图 c 则包含了所有十一扇已导出的窗户，其起始值为 0,16, … \ldots ,160，且没有基于本地化的选择。 对于每扇窗户，令 C j ∈ { 𝒫 , 𝒮 , 0.5 ​ ℰ } C_{j}\in\{\mathcal{P},\mathcal{S},0.5\mathcal{E}\}，且 𝒲 = 1 + ∑ j C j \mathcal{W}=1+\sum_{j}C_{j}。 上排报告了 100 ​ ∑ C j / ∑ ( 𝒲 − 1 ) 100\sum C_{j}/\sum(\mathcal{W}-1) 的值，其中求和范围涵盖所有四个未来组别以及全部 196 个空间位置。 单位楼层仅被排除在此构成比之外。 下排分别对 𝒲 \mathcal{W} 和 𝒲 − C j \mathcal{W}-C_{j} 在同一位置范围内进行归一化，并报告了 100 ​ TV 100\,\mathrm{TV} 的值，其中 TV ⁡ ( p , q ) = 1 2 ​ ∑ | p − q | \mathrm{TV}(p,q)=\tfrac{1}{2}\sum|p-q|。 单位楼层在两种分布中均被保留；在此最终分布归一化之前，没有任何剩余组件被重新计算或重新归一化。 这衡量的是分配规则在固定输出下的敏感度，而非缺少某个组件时训练所产生的影响。 共享行标尺为 0–100% 和 0–5%；下排的点表示可用窗户，而线条则连接相邻的观测值。 上排的堆叠份额在相邻窗户之间以线性方式连接。

paragraphs.en: Component share measures weight magnitude, whereas removal TV measures its effect on the normalized allocation. These complementary statistics describe one demonstration at fixed model parameters.

sents.en: Component share measures weight magnitude, whereas removal TV measures its effect on the normalized allocation.

paragraphs.en: Sixteen task videos provide recorded manipulation sequences. Tasks 04, 06, 08, and 11 appear in Figure 4 ; Figures 8 – 10 cover the twelve other recorded tasks. Each row contains four chronologically ordered frames from one video: initial configuration, task-specific intermediate events, and a visible terminal configuration. Selection follows actions rather than equal time intervals; timestamps are source-video times. Task 15 places a hamburger in a takeaway box and closes the lid; its final frame shows both arms returned. Task 16 packs a phone into its box and fits the lid. This supplementary task is excluded from the fifteen-task main comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 十六个任务视频提供了记录下来的操作序列。 任务 04、06、08 和 11 出现在图 4 中；图 8–10 涵盖了另外十二个记录的任务。 每一行都包含来自一个视频的四个按时间顺序排列的帧：初始配置、任务特定的中间事件以及可见的最终配置。 选择依据是动作而非相等的时间间隔；时间戳为源视频的时间。 任务 15 将汉堡包放入外卖盒中并盖上盖子；其最后一帧显示两只手臂均已收回。 任务 16 将手机装入其包装盒中并盖上盖子。 这个补充任务不包含在十五个任务的主要比较中。

sents.zh: 十六个任务视频提供了记录下来的操作序列。

sents.en: Tasks 04, 06, 08, and 11 appear in Figure 4 ; Figures 8 – 10 cover the twelve other recorded tasks.
sents.zh: 任务 04、06、08 和 11 出现在图 4 中；图 8–10 涵盖了另外十二个记录的任务。

sents.zh: 任务 15 将汉堡包放入外卖盒中并盖上盖子；其最后一帧显示两只手臂均已收回。

sents.en: Task 16 packs a phone into its box and fits the lid.
sents.zh: 任务 16 将手机装入其包装盒中并盖上盖子。

sents.en: This supplementary task is excluded from the fifteen-task main comparison.
sents.zh: 这个补充任务不包含在十五个任务的主要比较中。

paragraphs.en: All 64 frames are decoded directly from the sixteen original videos at the reported timestamps. Tight opaque masks cover incidental packaging and equipment text, including chest branding; additional masks cover the visible torso while preserving foreground arms and hands. Task-defining numerals and mahjong symbols, timestamps, and stage labels are retained. Original cloth marks, object details, and robot poses are retained. Display frames are downsampled and JPEG-compressed; no generative editing or inpainting is applied. Original videos and unmasked extracted frames are retained.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 64 帧画面均直接从十六段原始视频中，按照报告的时间戳进行解码。 紧密且不透明的遮罩覆盖了附属包装和设备上的文字，包括胸部的品牌标识；额外的遮罩则覆盖了可见的躯干部分，同时保留了前景中的手臂和手部。 定义任务所需的数字、麻将符号、时间戳和舞台标签均被保留。 原始的织物标记、物体细节和机器人姿态均被保留。 显示帧经过降采样和 JPEG 压缩；未进行任何生成式编辑或内容填充。 原始视频以及未应用遮罩的提取帧均被保留。

sents.en: All 64 frames are decoded directly from the sixteen original videos at the reported timestamps.
sents.zh: 所有 64 帧画面均直接从十六段原始视频中，按照报告的时间戳进行解码。

sents.en: Tight opaque masks cover incidental packaging and equipment text, including chest branding; additional masks cover the visible torso while preserving foreground arms and hands.

sents.en: Original videos and unmasked extracted frames are retained.
sents.zh: 原始视频以及未应用遮罩的提取帧均被保留。

paragraphs.en: For packing a phone into its box and closing the lid, the supplied results report SRs of 5% for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 85% for Ours.
paragraphs.zh: 在将手机装入包装盒并盖上盒盖的任务中，提供的结果显示，π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的 SR 为 5%，而“我们的方法”的 SR 为 85%。

paragraphs.en: Completed task results and failure evidence are supplied to an improvement agent based on Claude Opus 5 or GPT 5.6 Sol. The agent returns a post-training proposal specifying the parent policy, target behaviors, training-data allocation, and parameter-update scope. Training produces a candidate for task-level evaluation. Improved task capabilities enter the repertoire; unsuccessful candidates are excluded from active execution. Evaluation outcomes feed the next proposal, linking policy learning to repeated experimental decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 Claude Opus 5 或 GPT 5.6 Sol，将任务完成结果和失败证据提供给改进智能体。 该智能体返回一份训练后提案，其中明确指定了父策略、目标行为、训练数据分配以及参数更新范围。 训练过程会产生一个用于任务级评估的候选方案。 经过改进的任务能力将被纳入可用技能库；未成功的候选方案则不会进入主动执行流程。 评估结果将反馈至下一份提案，从而将策略学习与反复的实验决策关联起来。

sents.en: Completed task results and failure evidence are supplied to an improvement agent based on Claude Opus 5 or GPT 5.6 Sol.
sents.zh: 基于 Claude Opus 5 或 GPT 5.6 Sol，将任务完成结果和失败证据提供给改进智能体。

sents.en: The agent returns a post-training proposal specifying the parent policy, target behaviors, training-data allocation, and parameter-update scope.
sents.zh: 该智能体返回一份训练后提案，其中明确指定了父策略、目标行为、训练数据分配以及参数更新范围。

sents.zh: 训练过程会产生一个用于任务级评估的候选方案。

sents.zh: 经过改进的任务能力将被纳入可用技能库；未成功的候选方案则不会进入主动执行流程。

sents.en: Evaluation outcomes feed the next proposal, linking policy learning to repeated experimental decisions.
sents.zh: 评估结果将反馈至下一份提案，从而将策略学习与反复的实验决策关联起来。

paragraphs.en: The full system combines task-specialized policies developed on the RAP-WAM substrate. Its task-to-policy assignment is part of the evaluated system specification. SR and Score for a task refer to the same policy execution record; parameters and within-episode action fragments are not averaged across policies. The numerical source manifest preserves task identities, policy identities, and original summary paths.
paragraphs.zh: 完整系统整合了在 RAP-WAM 基板上开发的任务专用策略。 其任务到策略的分配是所评估的系统规范的一部分。 某项任务的 SR 和 Score 指的是同一策略执行记录；参数和单轮内的动作片段不会在多个策略之间取平均值。 数值源清单保留了任务身份、策略身份以及原始摘要路径。

sents.en: The full system combines task-specialized policies developed on the RAP-WAM substrate.
sents.zh: 完整系统整合了在 RAP-WAM 基板上开发的任务专用策略。

sents.en: Its task-to-policy assignment is part of the evaluated system specification.
sents.zh: 其任务到策略的分配是所评估的系统规范的一部分。

sents.en: SR and Score for a task refer to the same policy execution record; parameters and within-episode action fragments are not averaged across policies.
sents.zh: 某项任务的 SR 和 Score 指的是同一策略执行记录；参数和单轮内的动作片段不会在多个策略之间取平均值。

sents.en: The numerical source manifest preserves task identities, policy identities, and original summary paths.
sents.zh: 数值源清单保留了任务身份、策略身份以及原始摘要路径。

paragraphs.en: The complete system has Generalization SR/Score of 10.50/14.375, Precision 21.0255/28.6617, Long-Horizon 36.5000/48.4318, Memory 9.3333/10.3167, and Open 0.75/1.1625. Applying Equation 12 gives 15.6218% SR and 20.5895 Score, rounded to 15.62% and 20.59 in the main text. Table 1 shows Generalization’s standard and random columns separately, reconstructed from the corresponding task-policy records. The local base comparison uses identical capability denominators.
paragraphs.zh: 完整系统的泛化 SR/分数为 10.50/14.375，精确率为 21.0255/28.6617，长期规划能力为 36.5000/48.4318，记忆能力为 9.3333/10.3167，开放能力为 0.75/1.1625。 应用公式 12 可得 SR 为 15.6218%，分数为 20.5895%，在正文中四舍五入为 15.62% 和 20.59%。 表 1 分别展示了泛化能力的标准列和随机列，这些列是根据相应的任务-策略记录重构的。 本地基线比较使用了完全相同的能力分母。

sents.en: The complete system has Generalization SR/Score of 10.50/14.375, Precision 21.0255/28.6617, Long-Horizon 36.5000/48.4318, Memory 9.3333/10.3167, and Open 0.75/1.1625.
Applying Equation 12 gives 15.6218% SR and 20.5895 Score, rounded to 15.62% and 20.59 in the main text.
sents.zh: 应用公式 12 可得 SR 为 15.6218%，分数为 20.5895%，在正文中四舍五入为 15.62% 和 20.59%。

sents.en: Table 1 shows Generalization’s standard and random columns separately, reconstructed from the corresponding task-policy records.
sents.zh: 表 1 分别展示了泛化能力的标准列和随机列，这些列是根据相应的任务-策略记录重构的。

sents.en: The local base comparison uses identical capability denominators.
sents.zh: 本地基线比较使用了完全相同的能力分母。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation uses 30 denoising steps, replanning every eight actions, nine-step Savitzky–Golay smoothing, and four-action boundary blending. Each task assignment identifies the policy architecture, checkpoint, normalizer, and inference path.
paragraphs.zh: 评估过程使用 30 个去噪步骤，每执行八个动作重新规划一次，采用九步 Savitzky–Golay 平滑处理以及四动作边界融合。 每个任务分配都会确定策略架构、检查点、归一化器和推理路径。

sents.en: Evaluation uses 30 denoising steps, replanning every eight actions, nine-step Savitzky–Golay smoothing, and four-action boundary blending.
sents.zh: 评估过程使用 30 个去噪步骤，每执行八个动作重新规划一次，采用九步 Savitzky–Golay 平滑处理以及四动作边界融合。

sents.en: Each task assignment identifies the policy architecture, checkpoint, normalizer, and inference path.
sents.zh: 每个任务分配都会确定策略架构、检查点、归一化器和推理路径。

paragraphs.en: Separating policy learning from agentic decision-making requires matched data, training compute, interaction counts, and retry budgets. The relevant comparisons are continued training without agent-guided intervention, refinement with history reset, and the complete feedback loop. Removing response-based credit tests the local learning rule; resetting experiment history tests the role of cross-round evidence. The reported system comparison evaluates the combined procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 将策略学习与智能体决策分离需要匹配的数据、训练计算资源、交互次数和重试预算。 相关的比较包括：在没有智能体引导干预的情况下继续训练、通过重置历史进行优化，以及完整的反馈循环。 移除基于响应的归因测试会检验局部学习规则；重置实验历史则会检验跨回合证据的作用。 所报告的系统比较评估了组合后的流程。

sents.en: Separating policy learning from agentic decision-making requires matched data, training compute, interaction counts, and retry budgets.
sents.zh: 将策略学习与智能体决策分离需要匹配的数据、训练计算资源、交互次数和重试预算。

sents.en: The relevant comparisons are continued training without agent-guided intervention, refinement with history reset, and the complete feedback loop.
sents.zh: 相关的比较包括：在没有智能体引导干预的情况下继续训练、通过重置历史进行优化，以及完整的反馈循环。

sents.en: Removing response-based credit tests the local learning rule; resetting experiment history tests the role of cross-round evidence.
sents.zh: 移除基于响应的归因测试会检验局部学习规则；重置实验历史则会检验跨回合证据的作用。

sents.en: The reported system comparison evaluates the combined procedure.
sents.zh: 所报告的系统比较评估了组合后的流程。

paragraphs.en: In the continuation experiment with demonstration replay, we start from base step 742500, updating all action-generating parameters with AdamW and cosine decay. Learning-rate warmup lasts 2,000 updates; rehearsal, state-substitution, and credit schedules restart over 5,000 updates. Its immutable demonstration sampler uses 50% natural replay, 20% task-balanced replay, 15% reliable failure-boundary windows, and 15% late-progress windows. The source covers 35 training tasks; failure-boundary evidence is available for 21. Five virtual epochs correspond to ten source-dataset equivalents, with a final training step of 145,585. The final repertoire uses intermediate checkpoints at 12,500, 25,000, and 50,000 steps; the last training checkpoint is not automatically the retained policy for every task.
paragraphs.zh: 在包含演示重放的延续实验中，我们从基础步骤 742500 开始，使用 AdamW 和余弦衰减更新所有动作生成参数。 学习率预热持续 2,000 次更新；重演、状态替换和奖励分配计划在 5,000 次更新期间重新开始。 其不可变的演示采样器使用 50% 的自然重放、20% 的任务平衡重放、15% 的可靠失败边界窗口以及 15% 的后期进展窗口。 该源数据集涵盖 35 个训练任务；其中 21 个任务提供了失败边界的证据。 五个虚拟周期相当于十个源数据集的等效量，最终训练步骤为 145,585。 最终的动作库在 12,500、25,000 和 50,000 步时使用中间检查点；最后一个训练检查点并非自动成为每个任务所保留的策略。

sents.en: In the continuation experiment with demonstration replay, we start from base step 742500, updating all action-generating parameters with AdamW and cosine decay.
sents.zh: 在包含演示重放的延续实验中，我们从基础步骤 742500 开始，使用 AdamW 和余弦衰减更新所有动作生成参数。

sents.en: Learning-rate warmup lasts 2,000 updates; rehearsal, state-substitution, and credit schedules restart over 5,000 updates.
sents.zh: 学习率预热持续 2,000 次更新；重演、状态替换和奖励分配计划在 5,000 次更新期间重新开始。

sents.en: Its immutable demonstration sampler uses 50% natural replay, 20% task-balanced replay, 15% reliable failure-boundary windows, and 15% late-progress windows.
sents.zh: 其不可变的演示采样器使用 50% 的自然重放、20% 的任务平衡重放、15% 的可靠失败边界窗口以及 15% 的后期进展窗口。

sents.en: The source covers 35 training tasks; failure-boundary evidence is available for 21.
sents.zh: 该源数据集涵盖 35 个训练任务；其中 21 个任务提供了失败边界的证据。

sents.en: Five virtual epochs correspond to ten source-dataset equivalents, with a final training step of 145,585.
sents.zh: 五个虚拟周期相当于十个源数据集的等效量，最终训练步骤为 145,585。

sents.en: The final repertoire uses intermediate checkpoints at 12,500, 25,000, and 50,000 steps; the last training checkpoint is not automatically the retained policy for every task.
sents.zh: 最终的动作库在 12,500、25,000 和 50,000 步时使用中间检查点；最后一个训练检查点并非自动成为每个任务所保留的策略。

paragraphs.en: The final assignment retains the base for 14 of 42 tasks and uses 16 specialist checkpoints for the other 28, drawing on 30 recorded candidate identities. Nine specialists are obtained within 5,000 additional optimization steps, indicating that useful task-specific refinements can emerge from short training runs. Success improves on 24 tasks; four other substitutions improve Score at unchanged SR. The capability-balanced SR gain is 2.7697 percentage points, from 12.8520% to 15.6218%. These checkpoint budgets describe the retained solutions; total development cost also includes longer training branches and candidate evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 最终分配方案保留了 42 项任务中 14 项的基础模型，并为其余 28 项使用了 16 个专家检查点，同时参考了 30 个已记录的候选身份。 在额外 5,000 步优化步骤内获得了九位专家，这表明即使是短期训练也能产生对特定任务有用的改进。 成功改进了 24 项任务；另外四种替换方案在未改变 SR 的情况下提升了得分。 能力平衡的 SR 提升为 2.7697 个百分点，从 12.8520% 提升至 15.6218%。 这些检查点预算描述了保留的解决方案；总开发成本还包括更长的训练分支和候选评估。

paragraphs.en: The RAP-WAM base and post-trained repertoire use no external embodied pretraining. Task-policy selection uses observed evaluation results; the reported evidence does not include an independent held-out policy-selection test. Runs also differ in RNG and live-VAE metadata, so they are not paired stochastic replicates. This RoboDojo comparison evaluates integrated simulation performance. Real-robot results are reported separately in Figure 4 .
paragraphs.zh: RAP-WAM 基座和后续预训练模型均未使用任何外部的具身化预训练。 任务策略的选择基于观察到的评估结果；所报告的证据并未包含独立的、预留用于策略选择的测试集。 不同运行实例在 RNG 和实时 VAE 元数据上也存在差异，因此它们并非成对的随机重复实验。 此次 RoboDojo 对比旨在评估集成模拟性能。 真实机器人的实验结果在图 4 中单独报告。

paragraphs.en: For each task, the execution profile records the fraction of failed episodes with positive partial-completion scores, together with a center c t c_{t} and quartiles q 25 , t , q 75 , t q_{25,t},q_{75,t} . Boundary replay is enabled for eligible tasks whose positive-failure fraction reaches a reliability threshold τ rel \tau_{\rm rel} . A demonstration window at offset k k has normalized progress p = k / max ⁡ ( 1 , L − H ) p=k/\max(1,L-H) , with p = 1 p=1 if no offset range is available; L L is episode length and H H the required sequence span. Set b t = clip ⁡ ( b min + κ ⁡ ( q 75 , t − q 25 , t ) , b min , b max ) b_{t}=\operatorname{clip}(b_{\min}+\kappa(q_{75,t}-q_{25,t}),b_{\min},b_{\max}) and proximity w = exp [ − ( p − c t ) 2 / ( 2 b t 2 ) ] w=\exp[-(p-c_{t})^{2}/(2b_{t}^{2})] . The boundary pool contains windows with w ≥ τ boundary w\geq\tau_{\rm boundary} ; an empty pool falls back to the K fallback K_{\rm fallback} highest-proximity windows, capped by the available count. The late-progress pool uses p ≥ τ late p\geq\tau_{\rm late} . This transfers a task-level score profile to demonstration progress as a sampling heuristic, rather than estimating a physical failure time.

paragraphs.en: The training distribution combines natural replay, task-balanced replay, boundary replay, and late-progress replay with nonnegative proportions α natural , α balanced , α boundary , α late \alpha_{\rm natural},\alpha_{\rm balanced},\alpha_{\rm boundary},\alpha_{\rm late} summing to one. A virtual epoch preserves one complete pass over the source windows and adds the other pools in these proportions. Additional samples are balanced across eligible tasks and drawn uniformly within each task pool, with replacement only when the requested count exceeds pool size. Images and action labels remain unchanged. The selected parent is then optimized using the existing RAP-WAM objectives. The backbone and action interface use separate learning rates η backbone \eta_{\rm backbone} and η interface \eta_{\rm interface} ; the latter covers the action head, action/state encoders, query tokens, and projections. The optimizer runs within a specified update budget, saving candidates at a prescribed interval for evaluation. The replay-intervention parameter values above specify the thresholds, mixture proportions, optimizer configuration, and checkpoint schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 训练分布结合了自然重播、任务平衡重播、边界重播和晚期进展重播，其非负比例 α natural、α balanced、α boundary 和 α late（即 α_{\rm natural},\alpha_{\rm balanced},\alpha_{\rm boundary},\alpha_{\rm late}）之和为 1。 一个虚拟周期会完整遍历一次源窗口，并按这些比例添加其他池中的样本。 额外样本在所有符合条件的任务间保持平衡，并在每个任务池内均匀抽取；仅当所需数量超过池大小时才进行重复抽样。 图像和行动标签保持不变。 随后，使用现有的 RAP-WAM 目标函数对选定的父模型进行优化。 主干网络和行动接口分别使用不同的学习率 η backbone（即 η_{\rm backbone}）和 η interface（即 η_{\rm interface}）；后者涵盖行动头、行动/状态编码器、查询令牌和投影层。 优化器在指定的更新预算内运行，并以预设的间隔保存候选模型以供评估。 上述重播干预参数值定义了阈值、混合比例、优化器配置和检查点计划。

paragraphs.en: All reported aggregates use the same 42-task definition. Each task uses its valid evaluated layouts; the evaluation records contain 49 for Deposit coin and 44 for Fill egg holder, shared by the base and candidate policies. The source summaries and per-layout records were cross-checked; duplicate records were counted once. Candidate selection uses observed SR first and Score to break ties, with both metrics taken from one policy. Deposit coin uses P07 at 12,500 post-training steps (5/49 successes, Score 14.6939); Fill egg holder retains the base (0/44, Score 12.9545). Metrics are computed directly over these valid episodes. The unified base aggregate is 12.8520% SR / 17.8602 Score, and the system aggregate is 15.6218% / 20.5895, a gain of 2.7697 percentage points and 2.7293 Score.
paragraphs.zh: 所有已报告的聚合结果均使用相同的 42 项任务定义。 每项任务均使用其有效的评估布局；评估记录显示，Deposit coin 有 49 条记录，Fill egg holder 有 44 条记录，这些记录由基础策略和候选策略共享。 来源摘要与每个布局的记录均已交叉核对；重复记录仅计一次。 候选选择首先使用观测到的 SR，若出现平局则使用 Score 进行决断，两项指标均取自单一策略。 Deposit coin 在训练后第 12,500 步时采用 P07（成功次数 5/49，Score 为 14.6939）；Fill egg holder 则保留基础策略（成功次数 0/44，Score 为 12.9545）。 各项指标均直接基于这些有效回合计算得出。 统一的基础聚合结果为 SR 12.8520% / Score 17.8602，系统聚合结果则为 15.6218% / 20.5895，分别提升了 2.7697 个百分点和 2.7293 的 Score。

sents.en: Deposit coin uses P07 at 12,500 post-training steps (5/49 successes, Score 14.6939); Fill egg holder retains the base (0/44, Score 12.9545).
sents.zh: Deposit coin 在训练后第 12,500 步时采用 P07（成功次数 5/49，Score 为 14.6939）；Fill egg holder 则保留基础策略（成功次数 0/44，Score 为 12.9545）。

sents.en: Metrics are computed directly over these valid episodes.
sents.zh: 各项指标均直接基于这些有效回合计算得出。

sents.en: The unified base aggregate is 12.8520% SR / 17.8602 Score, and the system aggregate is 15.6218% / 20.5895, a gain of 2.7697 percentage points and 2.7293 Score.
sents.zh: 统一的基础聚合结果为 SR 12.8520% / Score 17.8602，系统聚合结果则为 15.6218% / 20.5895，分别提升了 2.7697 个百分点和 2.7293 的 Score。

paragraphs.en: The base has the highest aggregate SR and Score among the individual checkpoints in this candidate pool. Nevertheless, refinements improve subsets of tasks while regressing on others. The retained assignment combines these local gains and reaches 15.62% SR and 20.59 Score. This distinguishes a task-specialized improvement from a universal improvement of one checkpoint. All candidate results are shown, including candidates excluded from the repertoire. The comparison uses the observed results involved in policy selection; the system point is reconstructed from its task assignments, rather than an independent validation or evidence that the same gains persist under new seeds. Inference metadata differences are described in Appendix H .
paragraphs.zh: 在该候选池中，该基线模型在所有单独的检查点中拥有最高的综合 SR 和分数。 然而，优化虽然提升了部分子集任务的表现，却导致其他任务的性能下降。 保留的分配方案结合了这些局部增益，最终达到了 15.62% 的 SR 和 20.59 的分数。 这与单一检查点的通用性提升不同，而是一种针对特定任务的优化。 所有候选结果均已展示，包括未被纳入最终方案的那些候选者。 该比较使用了策略选择过程中涉及的实际观察结果；系统得分是根据其任务分配重新构建的，而非通过独立验证或证据来证明相同增益在新初始条件下依然成立。 推理元数据的相关差异在附录 H 中有详细说明。

paragraphs.en: Building on execution-feedback approaches ( Xiao et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) , the outer improvement loop uses experiment results to guide continued training, retain useful task specializations, and combine them through task-conditioned execution. Its state X r = ( ℬ r , g r , ℋ r ) X_{r}=(\mathcal{B}_{r},g_{r},\mathcal{H}_{r}) contains the policy repertoire, task assignment, and experiment history; the repertoire initially contains RAP-WAM. Training creates candidates, while evaluation and retention determine which capabilities remain available.
paragraphs.zh: 在执行-反馈方法（Xiao 等人，2026；Lu 等人，2026）的基础上，外层改进循环利用实验结果指导持续训练，保留有用的任务专业化能力，并通过任务相关的执行将它们结合起来。 其状态 X r = ( ℬ r , g r , ℋ r ) X_{r}=(\mathcal{B}_{r},g_{r},\mathcal{H}_{r}) 包含策略库、任务分配和实验历史；该策略库最初包含 RAP-WAM。 训练过程生成候选方案，而评估与保留机制则决定哪些能力能够继续可用。

sents.en: Building on execution-feedback approaches ( Xiao et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) , the outer improvement loop uses experiment results to guide continued training, retain useful task specializations, and combine them through task-conditioned execution.

paragraphs.en: At round r r , completed experimental results are supplied to a language-model-based improvement agent. Its input ℱ r \mathcal{F}_{r} contains task outcomes, execution trajectories, and available model diagnostics; the agent uses these results to design the next post-training procedure. The agent compares weak task behavior with previous interventions in ℋ r \mathcal{H}_{r} to formulate a hypothesis about a learning bottleneck. It then specifies u r u_{r} : the parent policy, target tasks or execution phases, the data or training-code change, and the trainable parameter set. This is a decision about the learning procedure; the policy optimizer carries out the resulting update: The intervention and optimization are defined by Equation 10 . Agent-guided refinement yields multiple task specializations with only a few thousand fine-tuning steps, reusing existing policies and demonstrations. The operator 𝒰 RAP \mathcal{U}_{\rm RAP} updates designated parameters from a parent checkpoint while preserving that policy. The replay intervention below instantiates this process; implementation details and workflow provenance appear in Appendix H .
paragraphs.zh: 在第 r 轮中，已完成实验的结果会被提供给一个基于语言模型的提升智能体。 其输入 ℱ r \mathcal{F}_{r} 包含任务结果、执行轨迹和可用的模型诊断信息；该智能体利用这些结果来设计下一阶段的后续训练流程。 该智能体将较弱的任务表现与 ℋ r \mathcal{H}_{r} 中先前的干预措施进行比较，从而构建一个关于学习瓶颈的假设。 接着，它会指定 u r u_{r}：即父策略、目标任务或执行阶段、数据或训练代码的变更，以及可训练的参数集合。 这是一个关于学习流程的决定；策略优化器会执行由此产生的更新：干预与优化由方程 10 定义。 智能体引导的优化过程仅需数千次微调步骤，即可生成多种任务特化版本，同时复用现有的策略和演示数据。 算子 𝒰 RAP \mathcal{U}_{\rm RAP} 会在保留父策略的同时，更新指定参数来自父检查点。 下方的重播干预实例化了这一过程；实现细节和工作流来源见附录 H。

paragraphs.en: History retains interventions, task-wise outcomes, and acceptance decisions, including rejected candidates. Later rounds can revise unsuccessful hypotheses and continue from useful specialists. Each evaluation is supplied back to the agent to design the next post-training round. The resulting loop is evaluate, propose, train, re-evaluate, and retain or discard. Discarding a policy does not imply discarding the experimental evidence used for the next decision.
paragraphs.zh: 历史记录会保留干预措施、任务结果以及接受决策，包括被拒绝的候选方案。 后续轮次可以修正未成功的假设，并从有用的专家处继续推进。 每次评估的结果都会反馈给智能体，用于设计下一轮训练后的步骤。 由此形成的循环是：评估、提出方案、训练、重新评估，然后保留或舍弃。 舍弃某项策略并不意味着要舍弃为下一次决策所使用的相关实验证据。

paragraphs.en: OpenVLA adapts vision–language representations to robot actions ( Kim et al., 2024 ) . G0.5 places reasoning and action in one autoregressive stream ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , while Xiaomi-Robotics-1 scales action-labeled pretraining ( Xiaomi Robotics Team et al., 2026 ) and Hy-Embodied uses modality-specific computation with a flow-based action expert ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Spatial Forcing supplies geometric alignment targets ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Our model learns its action interface on the target data. Its loss-coefficient rule uses the joint model’s own outputs and existing future targets, rather than requiring an additional pretrained robot expert or geometric-label pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: OpenVLA 将视觉-语言表示适配到机器人动作（Kim 等人，2024）。 G0.5 将推理与动作整合到单一自回归流中（Liu 等人，2026），而 Xiaomi-Robotics-1 扩展了带动作标签的预训练（Xiaomi Robotics Team 等人，2026），Hy-Embodied 则使用模态特定的计算并结合基于流的动作专家（Zhang 等人，2026）。 Spatial Forcing 提供了几何对齐目标（Li 等人，2026）。 我们的模型在目标数据上学习其动作接口。 其损失系数规则使用联合模型自身的输出和现有的未来目标，而无需额外的预训练机器人专家或几何标签处理流程。

sents.en: Our model learns its action interface on the target data.
sents.zh: 我们的模型在目标数据上学习其动作接口。

sents.en: Its loss-coefficient rule uses the joint model’s own outputs and existing future targets, rather than requiring an additional pretrained robot expert or geometric-label pipeline.
sents.zh: 其损失系数规则使用联合模型自身的输出和现有的未来目标，而无需额外的预训练机器人专家或几何标签处理流程。

paragraphs.en: Self Forcing trains video diffusion on self-generated context with sequence-level supervision ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . Our rehearsal instead supervises an adjacent recorded segment and retains its demonstration targets.
paragraphs.zh: Self Forcing 通过序列级监督，利用自生成上下文对视频扩散模型进行训练（Huang 等，2025）。 我们的排练方法则对相邻的已记录片段进行监督，并保留其演示目标。

sents.en: Self Forcing trains video diffusion on self-generated context with sequence-level supervision ( Huang et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: Self Forcing 通过序列级监督，利用自生成上下文对视频扩散模型进行训练（Huang 等，2025）。

sents.en: Our rehearsal instead supervises an adjacent recorded segment and retains its demonstration targets.
sents.zh: 我们的排练方法则对相邻的已记录片段进行监督，并保留其演示目标。

paragraphs.en: Scheduled sampling and interactive imitation learning address discrepancies between recorded demonstration inputs and histories produced by policy execution ( Bengio et al., 2015 ; Ross et al., 2011 ) . Our adjacent-segment training replaces observed inputs with predictions while retaining recorded demonstration targets; it neither collects new interactions nor inherits interactive data-aggregation guarantees. Prioritized replay and focal loss emphasize selected errors ( Schaul et al., 2016 ; Lin et al., 2017 ) ; importance sampling targets estimator variance ( Katharopoulos and Fleuret, 2018 ) , and value-aware model learning uses decision structure ( Farahmand et al., 2017 ) . response-based credit combines persistent error with action response, and projects the same response into spatial and temporal supervision. RoboDojo and RoboTwin offer complementary manipulation benchmarks ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2025 ) ; we report RoboDojo and real-robot task outcomes, alongside prediction diagnostics.
paragraphs.zh: 计划采样和交互式模仿学习解决了记录演示输入与策略执行所生成的历史之间的差异（Bengio 等，2015；Ross 等，2011）。 我们的相邻片段训练方法用预测结果替换观察到的输入，同时保留记录演示的目标；该方法既不会收集新的交互数据，也不会继承交互式数据聚合的保证。 优先重播和焦点损失强调选定的错误（Schaul 等，2016；Lin 等，2017）；重要性采样针对估计量的方差（Katharopoulos 和 Fleuret，2018），而价值感知模型学习则利用决策结构（Farahmand 等，2017）。基于响应的信用机制将持续存在的错误与动作响应相结合，并将相同的响应投射到空间和时间监督中。 RoboDojo 和 RoboTwin 提供了互补的操控基准（Chen 等，2026a；Chen 等，2025）；我们报告了 RoboDojo 和真实机器人任务的结果，以及预测诊断信息。

paragraphs.en: UWM couples video and action diffusion with independent modality timesteps ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) ; DreamZero jointly models video and actions to transfer across tasks and embodiments ( Ye et al., 2026b ) . Motus learns latent actions from optical flow ( Bi et al., 2026 ) , and MotuBrain extends joint modeling to multiview and cross-embodiment settings ( MotuBrain Team et al., 2026 ) . DreamGen generates synthetic task videos and recovers pseudo-actions using latent-action or inverse-dynamics models ( Jang et al., 2025 ) . Our rehearsal instead changes the conditioning context while retaining recorded demonstration targets; response-based credit then redistributes supervision within that training. These approaches provide architectural and data-generation context, not controlled evidence for the effect of our credit rule.
paragraphs.zh: UWM 将视频与动作扩散模型结合，并采用独立的模态时间步长（Zhu 等，2025）；DreamZero 则联合建模视频与动作，以实现跨任务与跨具身的迁移（Ye 等，2026b）。 Motus 从光流中学习潜在动作（Bi 等，2026），而 MotuBrain 则将联合建模扩展至多视角与跨具身场景（MotuBrain 团队等，2026）。 DreamGen 生成合成任务视频，并利用潜在动作模型或逆动力学模型恢复伪动作（Jang 等，2025）。 我们的排练方法则通过改变条件上下文来调整训练过程，同时保留记录下来的演示目标；随后，基于响应的信用机制会在此训练过程中重新分配监督信号。 这些方法提供了架构与数据生成的背景信息，但并未为我们的信用规则效应提供受控证据。

paragraphs.en: Figures 14 – 28 show one reproducible training example for 15 of the 16 real-robot tasks with external-view video sequences in Appendix G . Task 16 uses the completed Tencent Cloud phone-training run; its configuration, checkpoint, and sample identity were independently verified. Each example uses the final checkpoint of its audited task-training run. We select the median-length eligible continuous training segment and its middle legal two-chunk window, before inspecting predictions or attention. The archived exports used previously are replaced by these identified samples so that predictions and attention come from the same forward trajectory. Recorded targets belong to the same training sample as the prediction; the separately filmed external-view execution need not be the same episode. Each model receives only the conditioning observation and recorded current state at inference. There are no weight updates. The first column repeats the condition; offsets t + 1 , t + 4 , t + 8 , t + 12 , t + 16 t+1,t+4,t+8,t+12,t+16 index the sampled future sequence, not seconds.

paragraphs.en: Every predicted frame is labeled with RGB SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) ; figure-level SSIM and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) are arithmetic means over the five displayed future frames, excluding the condition. SSIM uses an 11 × 11 11\times 11 Gaussian window with σ = 1.5 \sigma=1.5 , population covariance, and channel averaging, excluding a five-pixel image border. LPIPS uses the official AlexNet network, version 0.1, at native resolution with inputs mapped to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . Both metrics use decoded float images clipped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , before privacy masks, quantization, or JPEG display compression. The orange dashed baseline (“Repeat current frame”) uses the current conditioning image itself as the prediction at every future position, without running the world model. For current image I t I_{t} and recorded future I t + h I_{t+h} , its plotted error is LPIPS ⁡ ( I t , I t + h ) \operatorname{LPIPS}(I_{t},I_{t+h}) . Thus it measures how much the recorded scene departs from remaining visually unchanged. Higher SSIM and lower LPIPS indicate closer images. We also retain metrics for all 16 predicted frames in the accompanying data.
paragraphs.zh: 每个预测帧都标注了 RGB SSIM（Wang 等人，2004）；图像级别的 SSIM 和 LPIPS（Zhang 等人，2018）是五个显示的未来帧的算术平均值，但不包括条件帧。 SSIM 使用一个 11×11 的高斯窗口（σ = 1.5），采用总体协方差和通道平均法，并排除图像边缘的五像素区域。 LPIPS 使用官方的 AlexNet 网络（版本 0.1），以原始分辨率运行，并将输入映射到 [−1, 1]。 两种指标都使用解码后的浮点图像，在应用隐私掩码、量化或 JPEG 显示压缩之前将其裁剪至 [0, 1]。 橙色虚线基线（“重复当前帧”）在每个未来位置都将当前的条件图像本身用作预测结果，而无需运行世界模型。 对于当前图像 I_t 和记录的未来图像 I_{t+h}，其绘制的误差为 LPIPS(I_t, I_{t+h})。 因此，它衡量了记录的场景在多大程度上偏离了保持视觉不变的状态。 SSIM 值越高、LPIPS 值越低，表示图像越接近。 我们还在随附的数据中保留了所有 16 个预测帧的指标。

paragraphs.en: The bottom strip shows the condition with a fixed task-region rectangle, predictive-query attention, mean absolute RGB prediction error over the five displayed future frames, and the horizon-wise LPIPS curve. Rectangles were marked from condition images and checked for visible task coverage, independently of attention magnitude; they are coarse task regions, not object segmentations, and do not track moving objects. Region SSIM and MAE use the same rectangle in each future frame. A read-only probe records the actual self-attention query/key tensors after normalization and rotary encoding, retaining the model’s additive mask and full softmax denominator. We average all 24 heads and 16 predictive-query rows at layers 10, 20, and 30, and denoising iterations 4, 8, and 16. We then display attention to the conditioning-time visual tokens. The spatial grid is 7 × 7 7\times 7 , displayed without smoothing. Attention color is density relative to a uniform spatial distribution after conditioning on the displayed view, using a common 0 0 – 4 × 4\times scale; error uses a common [ 0 , 0.15 ] [0,0.15] scale. Values beyond either scale are clipped for display only. Region enrichment is its fraction of attention divided by its fraction of image area; 1 denotes uniform allocation. Raw attention masses and layer/iteration maps are retained.
paragraphs.zh: 底部条带显示了固定任务区域矩形、预测查询注意力、五个显示的未来帧上的平均绝对 RGB 预测误差以及按时间步长的 LPIPS 曲线的情况。 矩形是从条件图像中标记出来的，并检查其是否覆盖可见的任务区域，这与注意力强度无关；它们是粗略的任务区域，而非物体分割，也不会跟踪移动物体。 区域的 SSIM 和 MAE 在每个未来帧中都使用相同的矩形。 一个只读探针在归一化和旋转编码后记录实际的自注意力查询/键张量，同时保留模型的加法掩码和完整的 softmax 分母。 我们在第 10、20 和 30 层以及去噪迭代第 4、8 和 16 次时，对所有 24 个头和 16 个预测查询行取平均值。 然后我们展示对条件时间视觉标记的注意力。 空间网格为 7 × 7 7\times 7，显示时未进行平滑处理。 注意力的颜色表示相对于在显示视图上进行条件化后的均匀空间分布的密度，使用共同的 0 0 – 4 × 4\times 比例；误差使用共同的 [ 0 , 0.15 ] [0,0.15] 比例。 超出任一比例的数值仅为显示目的而被截断。 区域富集度是其注意力占比除以图像面积占比；1 表示均匀分配。 原始注意力质量和层/迭代映射均被保留。

paragraphs.en: Across these 15 selected examples, mean SSIM is 0.879 versus 0.814 for persistence, and mean LPIPS is 0.018 versus 0.095. Under the fixed aggregation, 1 of 15 task regions have attention enrichment above 1. Thus these maps do not establish preferential attention to task objects or accurate object recognition. They are descriptive internal diagnostics, not causal explanations. The examples come from training data and different task checkpoints; they do not establish held-out prediction quality, task success, or the separate contribution of response-based credit or agentic refinement. Incidental text and visible background faces are masked at paired locations; task numerals and mahjong symbols remain. Display editing is limited to deterministic masking, display downsampling, and compression.
paragraphs.zh: 在这 15 个选定示例中，平均 SSIM 为 0.879，而持续性方法的平均值为 0.814；平均 LPIPS 为 0.018，而后者为 0.095。 在固定聚合条件下，15 个任务区域中仅有 1 个区域的注意力增强值高于 1。 因此，这些图并未表明对任务对象的优先关注或准确的对象识别。 它们只是描述性的内部诊断工具，而非因果解释。 这些示例来自训练数据和不同的任务检查点；它们无法证明保留测试集上的预测质量、任务成功性，或基于响应的信用分配与智能体优化各自的贡献。 无关文本和可见的背景人脸在对应位置已被掩码；任务数字和麻将符号则保留不变。 显示编辑仅限于确定性掩码、显示降采样和压缩。

paragraphs.en: The fourth diagnostic panel in each task figure plots LPIPS over all 16 predicted frames, against the copy-condition baseline, using a common vertical scale within each domain. Figure 13 aggregates all 15 real-robot and 35 simulation windows with equal task and frame weights. Full-horizon mean LPIPS decreases by 81.8% for real robots and 86.3% for simulation, computed as one minus the ratio of the model and baseline grand means. Every task has a lower full-horizon mean, although individual frames can favor persistence; all frames and tasks are retained. These comparisons demonstrate improved future-image fidelity over repeating the current observation on the selected training windows. They do not isolate the contribution of response-based credit or compare against an independently trained base model.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务图中的第四个诊断面板绘制了所有 16 个预测帧的 LPIPS 值与复制条件基线的对比，并在每个域内使用共同的垂直标度。 图 13 汇总了所有 15 个真实机器人窗口和 35 个模拟窗口，并赋予相同的任务权重和帧权重。 全时域平均 LPIPS 在真实机器人中下降了 81.8%，在模拟中下降了 86.3%，该值计算为 1 减去模型与基线总体均值之比。 每个任务的平均全时域值都更低，尽管个别帧可能更倾向于保持性；所有帧和任务均被保留。 这些比较表明，在选定的训练窗口上，未来图像的保真度优于重复当前观察的结果。 它们并未单独分析基于响应的奖励的贡献，也未与独立训练的基线模型进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Figures 29 – 63 show one identified training example for each of the 35 RoboDojo training tasks (task IDs 00–34). All examples use the retained post-training checkpoint P09 (step 50,000) described in Appendix H . We preserve the training loader’s seed-42 validation exclusion, select the median-length eligible training episode per task, and use its middle legal two-chunk window. Task IDs are verified against dataset metadata, and the corresponding task-language embedding is explicitly supplied during inference. Each figure pairs the recorded future with a 16-frame prediction sampled using 16 denoising steps. Inputs are the conditioning image, current state, and task-language embedding. The 30-step setting in Appendix A applies to policy evaluation. The original head-and-two-wrist camera mosaic is retained; task numbers denote dataset IDs, not difficulty ranks.
paragraphs.zh: 图 29–63 展示了 35 个 RoboDojo 训练任务（任务 ID 00–34）中每个任务的单个已识别训练示例。 所有示例均使用附录 H 中描述的训练后保留的检查点 P09（步骤 50,000）。 我们保留了训练加载器的 seed-42 验证排除设置，为每个任务选择符合条件的训练回合的中位数长度，并使用其中间合法的双片段窗口。 任务 ID 会与数据集元数据进行核对，并在推理过程中显式提供对应的任务语言嵌入。 每张图都将记录的未来状态与使用 16 次去噪步骤采样的 16 帧预测结果配对展示。 输入包括条件图像、当前状态以及任务语言嵌入。 附录 A 中的 30 步设置适用于策略评估。 原始的头部和双腕摄像头拼接图像被保留；任务编号表示数据集 ID，而非难度等级。

sents.zh: 图 29–63 展示了 35 个 RoboDojo 训练任务（任务 ID 00–34）中每个任务的单个已识别训练示例。

sents.zh: 任务 ID 会与数据集元数据进行核对，并在推理过程中显式提供对应的任务语言嵌入。

sents.zh: 输入包括条件图像、当前状态以及任务语言嵌入。

paragraphs.en: SSIM, LPIPS, the persistence baseline, and the fixed attention aggregation follow Appendix J . Global similarity metrics use the full original 384 × 320 384\times 320 camera mosaic. The diagnostic bottom strip shows only the head view, the upper 256 × 320 256\times 320 region; region metrics and attention enrichment are restricted to that view. The original attention grid is 12 × 10 12\times 10 over the mosaic, with an 8 × 10 8\times 10 head-view subgrid. It is displayed without smoothing across camera boundaries, with the same attention and error color scales as the real-robot figures. Region rectangles were marked from conditions and checked for visible task coverage, independently of attention magnitude.
paragraphs.zh: SSIM、LPIPS、持续性基线以及固定注意力聚合方法请参见附录 J。 全局相似性指标使用完整的原始 384 × 320 相机拼接图像。 诊断底部条仅显示头部视图，即上方的 256 × 320 区域；区域指标和注意力增强均限定于该视图。 原始注意力网格在拼接图像上为 12 × 10，其中头部视图的子网格为 8 × 10。 该图在未跨越相机边界处进行平滑处理的情况下显示，并采用与真实机器人图像相同的注意力和错误颜色标度。 区域矩形根据实验条件标记，并独立于注意力强度检查其是否覆盖可见任务区域。

paragraphs.en: Across the 35 selected training examples, mean SSIM is 0.942 versus 0.828 for the copy-condition baseline, and mean LPIPS is 0.018 versus 0.134. SSIM improves on persistence in 34 of 35 examples and LPIPS in all 35. None of the 35 marked regions has attention enrichment above 1 under this fixed aggregation, so these maps do not support a claim of object-localized attention or object-recognition accuracy. Coverage of all training task types is not a held-out evaluation: one window per task cannot establish average trajectory fidelity, causal component gains, or rollout success. Incidental text is masked for display while task-defining numbers, letters, and mahjong symbols are retained; metrics are computed before masking and compression.
paragraphs.zh: 在 35 个选定的训练示例中，平均 SSIM 为 0.942，而复制条件基线的平均值为 0.828；平均 LPIPS 为 0.018，而基线为 0.134。 在 35 个示例中，SSIM 在 34 个示例中优于持续性方法，LPIPS 则在全部 35 个示例中均更优。 在此固定聚合方式下，35 个标记区域中没有任何一个区域的注意力增强值超过 1，因此这些图无法支持关于物体局部化注意力或物体识别准确性的主张。 对所有训练任务类型的覆盖并非独立的评估：每个任务仅使用一个窗口无法确定平均轨迹保真度、因果组件增益或展开成功性。 显示时会对无关文本进行掩码处理，但定义任务的数字、字母和麻将符号会被保留；指标在掩码和压缩之前计算。
